title: Brahim Diaz shines as Morocco reaches AFCON quarterfinals
summary: Brahim Diaz scored the winning goal to lead Morocco to a 1-0 victory over Tanzania Sunday, securing their spot in the Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON) quarter-finals. The Real Madrid player made history by becoming the first Moroccan to score in four consecutive AFCON matches. Despite missing several chances, Morocco's dominant performance extended their unbea…
